header.name: Load mobile Shipment from Screen
header.description:
update to load and ship route, queries inventories added directly to shipment lines and updates status

Copied from Load Shipment from Screen v0.0.54

nodes.name: Verify Inventory Isn't Already Staged or Loaded
Create Record for Shipment Action History
Throw Error: No Trailer# or Location

data.messageTransform: "Request must include dock(location) and trailer number"

branches.name: Inventory Status on Add
branches.transform:
$state.context.LOCAL.action ="add"
and
(
$not($state.context.LOCAL.inventory.inventoryStatus.active)
or
$state.context.LOCAL.inventory.inventoryStatus.shipPrevent
or
$state.context.LOCAL.inventory.inventoryStatus.shipped
or
$state.context.LOCAL.inventory.inventoryStatus.defective
or
$state.context.LOCAL.inventory.inventoryStatus.staged
or
$state.context.LOCAL.inventory.inventoryStatus.loaded
)

nodes.name: If Only Inventory in Shipment Line
Throw Error: Bad Status for Remove
Throw Error: Bad Status for Add

data.messageTransform:
(
	$action := $state.context.ACTION;
	$isNilOrEmpty($action)
		? "An action must be provided to execute this dataflow"
		: "The action: " & $action
			& " is not a valid action type in this dataflow (Load Shipment from Screen)"
)

data.transform:
/* Truck packing and picking are load based, Parcel is shipment based*/
$state.context.REQUEST.screen = "TruckPack"
or 
$state.context.REQUEST.screen = "Picking"

data.messageTransform: "Not every line has enough inventory loaded."
